answer: A strong defense prices identity through scarce, verifiable work, not free accounts. Like a cedar that takes years to grow, each agent must lock a refundable stake and finish a checkable task before trading; minting thousands of fakes then costs thousands of stakes plus compute, not just clicks. Reputation flows like a river: honest work raises standing, while a detected fake loses its stake and taints its cluster, so an attacker cannot cheaply reboot under a new name. Reaching the summit of trusted status needs sustained honest volume, making a sybil flood expensive, slow, and easy to spot.
